title: Q3 company kickoff: briefing & OKR alignment playbook v0.1
body:
Purpose / context:
This playbook is a working draft for the company-wide Q3 kickoff (all-staff) and associated OKR alignment work. Goal is to: 1) communicate top-level focus and measurable goals, 2) surface team-level dependencies, 3) align cross-functional owners and timelines, and 4) provide a repeatable runbook for rehearsals and post-event follow-ups.

Where we are in the planning cycle:
- Q3 kickoff event date proposed: 2025-07-10 (Thu) 10:00–13:00 PT; company-wide + smaller breakout sessions after lunch.
- This document is v0.1 (internal draft) — expect v0.2 after exec review on 2025-06-09.
- Primary owners: Aisha (exec office) + Marco (product ops) for agenda and communications; Dana (people ops) for logistics.

Executive summary (one paragraph):
We need a concise Q3 narrative focused on "Serving at Scale": reliability targets, cost-efficiency playbook (Optimize), and enterprise expansion for Dedicated/Private. Proposed top-line company OKRs emphasize predictable latency and cost per token, 2 enterprise closed-won pilots, and internal developer productivity metrics. All-staff will hear the narrative, see data-backed progress, and leave with clear team-level commitments and a follow-up cadence.

Proposed company OKRs (draft, measurable targets) — for discussion in leadership review:
- O1: Delight customers with predictable, low-latency inference
  - KR1.1: 95th percentile hosted API latency <= 150 ms for generation SLO (qps-normalized)
  - KR1.2: Reduce production error-rate (5xx) by 60% vs baseline quarter
  - Owner: Eng - Serving Runtime (Sasha / eng-serving-runtime)

- O2: Drive cost-per-token improvements without material quality regression
  - KR2.1: Reduce per-token serving cost by 18% through batching, caching, and quantization configs on top 3 workloads
  - KR2.2: Ship Optimize automated recommendations pilot to 50 customers
  - Owner: Product - Optimize (Marco Chen)

- O3: Grow enterprise pipeline and deliver two Dedicated/Private customer launches
  - KR3.1: 2 new Dedicated contract signings (>= $200k ARR each)
  - KR3.2: Complete SOC2 gap remediation for on-prem package
  - Owner: GTM & Security (Elena / go-to-market + security-and-compliance)

- O4: Improve developer productivity and platform reliability internally
  - KR4.1: Reduce mean time to triage for incidents by 30%
  - KR4.2: Increase internal SDK adoption for new teams (tracked via route keys) by 25%
  - Owner: DevEx & SRE (Liam O'Neill / developer-experience)

Agenda (all-staff main session, 10:00–11:15 PT):
- 10:00–10:05: Welcome / framing (CEO) — 5 min
- 10:05–10:20: Company narrative + Q2 recap highlights (Exec Office) — 15 min
- 10:20–10:40: Key metrics deep-dive (Platform + Observability) — 20 min (live dashboards)
- 10:40–10:55: Product priorities (Hosted / Dedicated / Private) — 15 min
- 10:55–11:05: Customer story: enterprise pilot learnings (Customer Success) — 10 min
- 11:05–11:15: Callouts, next steps, how we’ll roll out OKRs to teams (People Ops + Exec) — 10 min

Breakouts / team huddles (11:30–13:00):
- Breakouts by org (eng subteams, product, go-to-market, support). Each breakout facilitator runs a 45-min session structured: 1) read the executive OKRs, 2) identify 2–3 team-level KRs that map to company KRs, 3) surface cross-team dependencies and blockers.

Pre-reads and assets to publish (timeline):
- 2025-06-09: Leadership review (collect feedback on draft OKRs) — responsible: Aisha/Marco
- 2025-06-20: Finalize company OKRs (v1) and publish pre-read + one-pager — responsible: Exec Office
- 2025-06-25: Slide deck lock (v1 of slides) — responsible: Slide owners
- 2025-07-03: Rehearsal #1 (exec leads) — responsible: Aisha
- 2025-07-08: Full run-through with hosts + AV check — responsible: Dana

Communication plan (who sees what / cadence):
- Pre-read (one-pager) published to Confluence and Drive one week before event (2025-07-03).
- Reminder emails: 2 weeks, 3 days, 1 day before event to all-staff. Managers asked to discuss OKRs in team meetings the week prior.
- Post-event: recording + annotated notes + template for team OKR proposals published within 48 hours.

Team-level OKR alignment process (post-all-hands):
- Week 0–1 post-event: teams draft proposed mappings to company KRs and identify owners/deps.
- Week 2: cross-functional review board (reps: Eng, Product, GTM, SRE, Security) convenes for conflicts/overlap resolution.
- Week 3: publish finalized team OKRs into tracking (Confluence + OKR tracker).

Rehearsals and runbook checklist:
- Slide owners: confirm slides + speaker notes by 2025-06-25.
- Exec rehearsal #1: 2025-07-03 (30–45 min) — focus on narrative, timing, handoffs.
- AV/streaming test: 2025-07-08 (full run-of-show).
- On day: 1 ops engineer on call for live dashboards, 1 comms lead monitoring Slack for Q&A.

Success metrics for the event (how we judge success):
- 80% of attendees report "clear on priorities" in quick pulse within 48 hrs.
- >60% of teams submit draft team OKRs within one week.
- Recording + assets viewed by 75% of company within two weeks.

Risks / open questions (leadership should resolve):
- Will the reliability targets be seen as realistic? (Need platform sign-off on feasibility and rollout plan.)
- Are we prioritizing cost reduction at the expense of quality? Need explicit quality guardrails per workload.
- Timeline for SOC2 remediation is tight — security to provide updated milestone plan before leadership review.

Appendix A: Slide ownership (working list) — confirm by 2025-06-20:
- CEO opening / narrative: CEO + Exec Office (Aisha)
- Metrics & dashboards: Observability (Priya) + Platform Eng (Ravi)
- Product roadmap highlights: Marco (Hosted, Dedicated, Private)
- Optimize product pilot update: Marco + Applied ML (Sasha)
- Customer success story: Elena + CS rep
- People ops call-to-action: Dana

Appendix B: Template for team mapping (to be published with pre-reads) — brief fields:
- Team name, proposed team OKRs (Title + 1–2 KRs), mapping to company OKRs (O1/O2/etc), owner(s), blockers/deps, measurement plan, risks.

Notes to self / TODOs (short bullets):
- Confirm event date with Exec calendar by 2025-05-12.
- Lock down customer speaker and NDA check (Elena).
- Create one-page pre-read and circulate to execs for edits on 2025-06-09 meeting.
- Build a short pulse survey for 48-hr feedback (small, single-screen).

Audience cues / facilitation tips (for hosts):
- Keep narrative tight — each exec has 3 talking points max.
- Use live data only for top-level dashboards; avoid deep live demos.
- During breakouts, facilitators should capture one prioritized dependency and one clear action item per team.

Version history:
- v0.1 (2025-05-06) initial draft — Aisha
- v0.2 (planned 2025-06-09) after leadership feedback

End of playbook draft.

(There are rough notes inlined — this doc intentionally mixes checklist language and narrative. Please add comments directly in Drive or ping Aisha in Slack for quick clarifications.)
